name: Avery Quinn
summary: I turn ambiguous ideas into useful, calm digital products. I work from the first sketch through a durable system that gives teams room to move.

experience.summary: Led product direction for a collaborative workspace used by growing teams. Shaped the system, shipped the new editor, and partnered closely with engineering from discovery through launch.
Designed end-to-end tools for independent businesses, from first-run onboarding to daily operations. Built a reusable component library that made new work faster and more consistent.
Made identities, websites, and small digital products for people doing interesting work. Learned to make the essential thing feel inevitable.
